svg.title: Delivery pipeline of Profile Weather View
svg.desc: Delivery pipeline: a git commit passes hk hooks (format, lint, typecheck), opens a pull request with a conventional title and release labels, crosses the gate (bun run check at 100 % coverage), is squash-merged to main and released as a tag and GitHub Release by semantic-release. Renovate pull requests enter at the same gate and automerge when it is green.
